detailed_results.question: Pipe A can fill a tank in 6 hours, while Pipe B can empty the same tank in 9 hours. If both pipes are opened together when the tank is empty, how many hours will it take to fill the tank completely?
Alice can code a feature in 4 hours, and Bob can code the same feature in 6 hours. If they work together at their constant rates, how many minutes will it take them to finish the feature?

A printer prints 30 pages per minute. A second printer prints 45 pages per minute. How many total pages can both printers produce together if the first runs for 20 minutes and the second runs for 15 minutes?
A bakery produces 120 loaves of bread in 3 hours with 2 bakers. How many loaves will 5 bakers produce in 4 hours, assuming all bakers work at the same constant speed?
A cyclist rides 30 miles at 15 miles per hour, then turns around and rides the same 30 miles back at 10 miles per hour. What is the total travel time in hours for the entire round trip?
Although Liam initially wanted 50 marbles, he only bought 35. His brother gave him 12 more marbles for his birthday. Later, Liam lost 8 marbles in the park. How many marbles does Liam currently have?

There were 80 passengers on a bus. At the first stop, 15 got off and nobody boarded. At the second stop, 22 passengers boarded and 7 got off. How many passengers remained on the bus after the second stop?
Sophia baked 60 cookies. She gave 20 cookies to her classmates, and half of the remaining cookies to her neighbors. If she ate 4 cookies herself, how many cookies are left?

A bookstore sold 45 mystery books on Friday. On Saturday, they sold twice as many mystery books as Friday. On Sunday, they sold 15 fewer mystery books than Saturday. How many total mystery books were sold across all three days?
Noah had $150. He spent $45 on groceries and $25 on gas. Before going home, he found a $20 bill on the sidewalk. How many dollars does Noah have now?
A jacket originally costs $200. It is discounted by 20%, and then an additional 10% coupon is applied to the discounted price. What is the final price of the jacket in dollars?
Maya deposits $500 in an account earning 10% annual simple interest. How much total money in dollars will be in the account after 3 years?
An item with a list price of $80 is subject to an 8% sales tax. Additionally, a $5 flat shipping fee is added to the total. What is the final checkout amount in dollars and cents?
A freelancer charges $50 per hour. She works 35 hours in a week. If 15% is deducted for taxes and $100 is deducted for equipment fees, what is her take-home pay in dollars?
A store sells coffee for $12 per bag. They offer a deal: buy 3 bags, get 1 bag free. If Oliver needs 12 bags of coffee, how much will he spend in dollars?
A farm has chickens and cows. There are 30 heads and 84 legs in total. Each chicken has 2 legs and each cow has 4 legs. How many cows are on the farm?
The sum of two numbers is 75, and their difference is 21. What is the value of the larger number?
A movie theater sold adult tickets for $10 and child tickets for $6. In one afternoon, they sold 100 tickets in total and collected $840. How many adult tickets were sold?
Ethan is 4 times as old as his son Lucas. In 6 years, Ethan will be 3 times as old as Lucas. How old is Ethan right now?
Two pens and three notebooks cost $17. Four pens and one notebook cost $19. What is the cost in dollars of a single pen?
A rectangular garden is 14 meters long and 8 meters wide. If a gardener increases both the length and width by 2 meters, by how many square meters does the area of the garden increase?
A square room has an area of 144 square feet. What is the perimeter of the room in feet?
A rectangular floor is 12 feet long and 9 feet wide. It is to be covered completely with square tiles that are 3 feet by 3 feet each. How many tiles are needed?
A cube has an edge length of 4 cm. If the edge length is doubled to 8 cm, what is the volume of the larger cube in cubic centimeters?
A triangular garden bed has a base of 15 meters and a height of 8 meters. What is the area of the garden bed in square meters?
